summary: Per-character sight events consumed by esv::StoryCharacterEventManager::OnSightEvents (Osiris notifications 0x1d/0x1e). Appears whenever characters see each other: spawned scenes, dialogues, fights, containers.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: OnSightEvents (EoCServer.dll+0xEF7030) passes +0 to ls::Guid::IsValid and to OsirisNotification::SetParamGuidValue for events of type 2.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: OnSightEvents resolves +0x10 with FUN_18025b5c0 (entity lookup) for every event - the other character of the event.

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: OnSightEvents asserts 'A sight event should always have a valid type' when +0x18 is 0, branches on 1 and 2.

fields.name: field_19
fields.evidence: For type 1 OnSightEvents logs +0x19 as true/false and passes (value == 1) to Osiris notification 0x1d.

fields.name: field_1A
fields.evidence: For type 2 OnSightEvents skips the event when +0x1A is 0.

fields.name: Events
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2E8A4B0 (0x40 bytes, HashMap zeroing) registers FUN_140591cf0, which destroys 0x10-byte values each holding an array (FUN_1405bd8a0) then the key set. macOS: ls::HashMap<ls::ID<EntityHandleTraits>, ls::DynamicArray<esv::sight::SightEvent>>::DestroyValues. OnSightEvents walks keys (+0x20, count +0x2C, stride 8, EntityIsAlive) and values (+0x30), elements stride 0x20. Live: 48 instances with key/value counts 1..0x1E.

open_questions: Names of SightEvent members (Guid at +0, the two bools).
